properties.site-address: Development Site At Bressenden Place Victoria Street Allington Street And Buckingham Palace Road London SW1E 5EF
properties.notes: Construction of a part six, part seven and part 10 storey building (Building 7b/7c) with new basement fronting Allington Street, Bressenden Place and Victoria Street for use as offices (Class B1), flexible retail (Classes A1-A5), flexible library/retail (Class D1/A1-5), flexible library/office (Class D1/B1), 42 residential units and associated works, including hard landscaping, highway, utilities and ancillary works with servicing from Bressenden Place.
